title: GraRe: Grasp Candidate Re-Ranking for Frozen 6-DoF Grasp Detectors
abstract: arXiv:2608.00946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing 6-DoF grasp detectors typically rank grasp candidates by detector confidence. However, our analysis on GraspNet-1Billion shows that detector confidence is often poorly aligned with grasp quality, leaving successful grasp candidates at low ranks. Motivated by this observation, we study whether learned re-ranking can improve candidate ordering while keeping detector parameters and grasp candidates unchanged. We propose GraRe, which estimates grasp quality from candidate attributes, shell-stratified local geometry, and object context. Candidate attributes condition the local geometric and object-context representations, and a Transformer fuses all three feature types. The predicted quality is combined with detector confidence to produce the final ranking. Experiments on GraspNet-1Billion with five frozen detectors show consistent improvements, with gains of up to 13.56 points in Average AP. Real-robot experiments further

translated_title: GraRe：面向冻结6自由度抓取检测器的抓取候选重排序
translated_abstract: 现有的6自由度抓取检测器通常依据检测器置信度对抓取候选进行排序。然而，我们在GraspNet-1Billion数据集上的分析表明，检测器置信度往往与实际抓取质量不一致，导致许多成功的抓取候选被排在较低位次。受此观察启发，我们研究了在保持检测器参数和抓取候选不变的情况下，学习型重排序能否改善候选排序。我们提出了GraRe，它从候选属性、壳层分层的局部几何以及物体上下文中估计抓取质量。其中候选属性对局部几何和物体上下文表示进行条件化，并通过Transformer融合这三种特征类型。预测的抓取质量与检测器置信度相结合，产生最终排序。在GraspNet-1Billion上对五个冻结检测器的实验显示了一致的性能提升，平均AP最高提升13.56个点。真实机器人实验进一步验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出GraRe重排序方法，通过Transformer融合候选属性、壳层分层局部几何和物体上下文来估计抓取质量，在不修改冻结检测器参数的情况下显著改善6自由度抓取候选排序，在GraspNet-1Billion上平均AP最高提升13.56个点。
